intro: A Schengen country with prices that are affordable for the EU and a well-developed IT scene. Budapest is the main capital, attractive for families and remote workers alike.
climate: Continental: cold, snowy winters and hot, dry summers. Sharp transitions between the seasons.
mentality: Reserved and formal at first glance, but genuinely friendly. A strong sense of national identity.
language_note: Hungarian is one of the most difficult languages in Europe (the Finno-Ugric group). English is widespread in Budapest; in the regions, German or Hungarian is essential.
visa_note: For Russian citizens, only the long-stay D visa is available, via employment, study, family or a company. Tourist Schengen visas have been issued only rarely since 2022.
